primary_suite: 41 tasks, at most 5 per engineering family
reserved_suite: 78 public-source cases hidden from primary model inputs; not contamination-proof
provider_neutral_submission: main.py and optional helper source files, frozen before offline replay
task_isolation: fresh workspace, read-only candidate inputs and submitted source, no evaluator targets or API credentials
runtime: pinned serial Python/CadQuery/Gmsh/scikit-fem/NumPy/SciPy; Docker backend requires an installed digest-pinned image
model_generation: record exact model/provider/version, prompt hashes, reasoning settings, token usage, API cost and generation time outside the replay sandbox
input_modalities: drawing tasks require identical image access; models without that capability belong to a separately labeled condition
ranking: No aggregate certified leaderboard claimed; unreproduced tasks and unsupported automatic physics validators are explicit
human_review: Still required for unsupported geometry/setup/field/convergence checks; blind reviewers to model identity
baseline_kind: trusted software solver; not a human expert and not a frontier-model result
